name: plugin
description: The participant and coach skills of the Antasphere Hackathon: /plugin:join (from zero to your team's app running), /plugin:check (the opening of every session: the clock, the doctor, the push received, the project description, the pacing), /plugin:demo (screenshots of your app, the demo deck on Slideless, its link on the platform), and for coaches /plugin:coach-brief (a team's chat, requests, decks and repository, summarized) and /plugin:coach-help (answer a help request, post on your word).
